response.rationale: NF1 background plus biphasic pattern (benign superficial neurofibroma-like and deep malignant features) with S100 positivity and negative smooth muscle markers strongly favors MPNST over benign neurofibroma or leiomyosarcoma.

rejected.why: Only accounts for superficial bland component and NF1 history, but misses deep malignant features and infiltrative growth.
